column1: # Fixture grid for the formula reference suite (P1-6). Columns: sheet, cell, type, value.
# type: number | text | bool | empty | date | formula
#   date    = number cell carrying a yyyy-mm-dd number format; value is the serial.
#   text    = text constant, value verbatim (may be empty or contain spaces).
#   empty   = no cell content at all.
#   formula = value is the formula text; its result is the cell value.
# Suite formulas are evaluated in the context of sheet Data (unqualified refs mean Data!).
